business_problem: Relationship Managers needed hours to complete ESG Assessment questionnaires of up to 80 questions from client ESG and CSR documents, creating operational inefficiency and data quality issues in a process embedded in BNP Paribas's credit risk workflow.
solution_summary: BNP Paribas built an internal AI Assistant into its impACT platform to accelerate ESG Assessments used by Relationship Managers and risk teams. In the workflow, Relationship Managers first upload relevant client ESG and CSR documents that were either publicly disclosed or shared during client meetings. The AI Assistant then launches analysis in impACT, where the documents are scanned and indexed and prompts are sent through Azure API to OpenAI's ChatGPT 4o mini model. The model returns suggested answers and justifications for questionnaire items, along with links to the exact document passages supporting each suggestion. The generated content is served back inside impACT rather than being auto-filled, so Relationship Managers must review, select, edit, and validate the proposed answers before submission. The resulting assessment feeds BNP Paribas's ESG synthesis and credit decision process, while the bank monitors answer relevancy, user feedback, and Azure LLM operating cost.

solution_components.role: Hosts the ESG Assessment workflow where Relationship Managers upload documents, launch analysis, review suggestions, and complete the final questionnaire.

solution_components.name: AI Assistant
solution_components.role: Presents suggested questionnaire answers, justifications, and linked document passages to help Relationship Managers complete assessments faster.

solution_components.name: ChatGPT 4o mini
solution_components.role: Generates answer suggestions from uploaded ESG and CSR documents and provides supporting rationale for each proposed response.

solution_components.name: Azure API
solution_components.role: Provides the API path BNP Paribas uses to call the ChatGPT 4o mini model from its internal application.

data_flow: Relationship Managers upload client ESG and CSR documents into impACT, then trigger the AI Assistant. The documents are scanned and indexed, prompts are sent through Azure API to ChatGPT 4o mini, and the model returns suggested answers plus comments and links to supporting passages. Those suggestions are displayed in impACT for Relationship Managers to review, edit, and use in the ESG Assessment and downstream credit-risk process.
integration_points: Client ESG/CSR documents disclosed publicly or shared during client meetings
business_outcome: The AI Assistant helps Relationship Managers complete ESG Assessments faster, simplifies analysis of client ESG strategy and risks, reduces data quality issues, and has achieved good user adoption while keeping Azure LLM operating cost low.
architecture_clues: The tool was internally developed by Group Data Office and CIB AI Platforms in collaboration with sustainability and company engagement stakeholders.
The AI displays suggested answers with comments referencing the relevant sections of the uploaded documents.
Answers are not pre-filled; Relationship Managers must actively select and can edit AI suggestions.
BNP Paribas tracks AI relevancy through quantitative and qualitative monitoring and also monitors Azure LLM run cost.
